subject: Private Offer: term-tier options + co-sell entitlements for Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Alice Bryant <alice.bryant@acmeanalytics.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private offer request: 24-month term + co-sell credits

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the product demo last week — the team at Acme Analytics is excited about Redwood's latency/cost profile. Procurement asked me to start a private-offer conversation so we can get pricing and term language baked into our procurement cycle. High-level ask below: 

- Term: 24 months (we prefer a multi-year agreement)
- Commitment: ~$420k ARR equivalent (usage-based but want an annualized commit)
- Pricing: target ~30% off published marketplace list year 1, with a step-down to 20% year 2
- Co-sell: request for joint marketing credit (one-time USD 25k) and a named account referral credit for FY28
- Buyer approval: procurement needs internal buyer approval windows and a sample PO/term sheet to circulate to legal

Can you confirm whether Redwood can issue an AWS Marketplace private offer with the above structure, and what approval path, signoff owners, and timelines we should expect? I've attached our procurement intake form for context.

Appreciate a quick read — happy to jump on a call later today if helpful.

Best,
Alice Bryant
Director, Strategic Procurement
Acme Analytics
[Attachment: Acme_PO_Request_20270502.pdf (pdf)]
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer request: 24-month term + co-sell credits

Forwarding Acme's procurement ask; see attached intake. Key items to decide:

Options I recommend we present (concise):
1) 24-month committed private offer — 25% off list Y1, 15% off Y2, $25k co-sell credit payable after launch. Requires Finance approval for >$400k ARR-equivalent commit.
2) 18-month hybrid — 28% off Y1, 18% off Y2, $15k co-sell credit. Faster internal approval path; keeps price protection while shortening exposure.
3) 12-month pilot + renewal option — 30% off Y1, renewal at list with negotiated discount; $10k co-sell credit. Lowest risk but may not meet buyer's procurement preferences.

Questions for you both:
- Vanessa: Can Sales accept 18 vs 24 months if we trade a modest co-sell credit? Do we need to involve Channel/Marketplace ops for private-offer pricing exceptions?
- Vivek: Are there quota/partner credit constraints for a $25k marketing credit on co-sell programs?
- Laura: Legal/Procurement — do you need a draft PO/term template from us to push this through Acme's legal? I attached a Redwood PO template.

Goal: provide Acme with 2 clear options by EOD tomorrow + timeline for internal approvals so they can circulate.

Thanks — Kar

[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template_20270502.pdf (pdf)]
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer request: 24-month term + co-sell credits

Karthik — thanks for the summary. High level decision guidance below: 

- Approve presenting options 1 and 2 to Acme. Lean toward Option 2 (18 months) as our standard concession for mid-market accounts — keeps sales velocity and limits multiyear exposure.
- Co-sell credit: approve up to $20k for joint marketing (must be credited against FY28 bookings), $25k requires Sales Director sign-off and Finance pre-clearance.
- Pricing guardrail: anything deeper than 30% off list needs VP Sales approval and justification (strategic account / upsell runway).
- Marketplace ops: include Marketplace team on the private-offer ticket so they can confirm AWS PO/term entitlements (billing cadence, SSO buyer mapping).

Action items:
- Kar: send the two-option table to Acme with explicit timelines and the PO template (we'll flag that 24-month requires Finance sign-off).
- Vivek: confirm whether partner/co-sell credits affect partner carveouts or revenue recognition — copy Finance if needed.
- Laura: prepare minimal contract redline checklist for Acme procurement to speed review.

I'll loop in Marketplace ops after we have the two-option note.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Alice Bryant <alice.bryant@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@acmeanalytics.com>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer request: 24-month term + co-sell credits

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the procurement intake form. Internal guidance below; I summarized two options we can present to Acme along with what each requires on our side. Please confirm which you prefer and whether you want us to open the Marketplace private-offer ticket now.

Option A — 18-month co-commit (recommended for speed)
- Pricing: 28% off published marketplace list year 1, 18% off year 2 (pro rata for 18-months).
- Co-sell: $20k joint marketing credit payable after first month of production and a named-account referral credit structure for FY28 (details to follow).
- Approval path: Sales Ops + Finance (standard approval lane) — expected internal turn ~3 business days once we submit the private-offer request.

Option B — 24-month multi-year (buyer-preferred)
- Pricing: 25% off list Y1, 15% off Y2.
- Co-sell: $25k one-time marketing credit (requires Director-level approval + Finance pre-clearance).
- Approval path: Sales Director + Finance + Marketplace Ops (estimated 5–7 business days internal).

What we'll do when you confirm:
1) Draft the private-offer terms and attach a PO-ready term sheet for your procurement (we'll include a short redline checklist for legal).
2) Open the AWS Marketplace private-offer request and tag Acme's buyer email for SSO mapping.
3) Share a mutual action plan with milestones (private-offer submission, legal review, signature, launch).

Quick ask: if you want the faster path (Option A), say so and we'll proceed with the private-offer ticket today. If you prefer the 24-month structure, note that we will need a brief Finance sign-off and an additional 2–3 business days.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Marketplace Sales (Americas)
Redwood Inference
